Name: Jonathan Joestar as Alex
Author: KuraiChanZ
Description:
This mod changes Alex's portraits to Jonathan Joestar

All I did was scale down the originals to fit the dimensions. This was more of a personal mod, but I decided why not put it out there. 
I can't do sprites so unfortunately, there are not sprites.

Installation:
Extract the .xnb file into the Stardew Valley > Content > Portraits folder and you're good to go.
